scope: post-outcome implementation diagnosis; no episode outcome is changed
observed_failure: the first candidate passed the executable public goal but the host-side evaluator-artifact audit rejected ordinary third-party .pyi files inside .bootstrap-venv
root_cause: bin/python was a container-created symlink whose final /root/.pyenv target was inaccessible from the host; calling Path.is_file before Path.is_symlink followed that target and raised PermissionError, so the otherwise valid virtual environment was not recognized
correction: test whether bin/python is a symlink before following it as a regular file; retain all pyvenv.cfg and activation-script checks
scientific_disposition: the original first replay remains recorded as Fail
the final second replay and Official Pass remain the observed endpoint
